messages:
Asha (partnerships): quick callout  we had a confusing handoff w/ CloudPenn yesterday. Need a lightweight partner SEV path: shared channel, bot triage, who posts updates to partner. Anyone seen good patterns?
Ben (support): yes - main problem was duplicate channels. Support created #cloudp-sev and partner created #cloudp-incident. We should auto-create a single canonical channel.
Talia (eng-sre): propose rule: webhook with severity >=1 -> partner-bot creates #partner-sev-{code}-{s}{-region} and invites mapped oncalls + partner reps.
Rory (ops): add logistics pin if hardware/SI involved. Also add expected-close ISO timestamp in pinned message so bots can auto-archive.
Asha (partnerships): ownership: Support = triage lead, Eng-SRE = infra lead, Partnerships = partner comms. Comms owner posts every 30m.
partner-bot: [automated] Received SEV webhook (source=cloudp, severity=1). Creating #partner-sev-cloudp-s1 and inviting: Asha, Ben, Talia, mapped oncalls.
Ben (support): need /invite-partner <partner-code> workflow so partner reps can be added quickly.
Talia (eng-sre): add ACK timers: if no vendor ack in 10m escalate to exec-oncall. Bot can monitor.
Rory (ops): I'll add a short triage template: incident one-liner, affected customers, mitigation, owners, next ETA. Pin it in channel.
Asha (partnerships): postmortem: combined doc - Support writes timeline, Eng-SRE writes RCA, Partnerships writes partner timeline + customer comms.
Ben (support): agreed. Let's test automation this week. Who can PR bot changes?
Talia (eng-sre): I'll open a PR for the bot rules by Thu.
Asha (partnerships): reconvene Fri 11am PT to review. Goal: join correct war room in <1m and clear ownership in <10m. :thumbsup:
